name: Abel-shittim
line: Abel-shittim, also called Shittim, was a place east of the Jordan on the plains of Moab, Israel's last camp before they crossed into Canaan.

moments.title: Camp by the Jordan
moments.text: Israel camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim. This was across from Jericho.
